messages.en: I've started taking better care of myself. I don't want to keep pushing myself to work late anymore.
That's good. Just take it easy at home tonight.

senses.en_definition: Yourself; you personally, used reflexively or as an expressive, sometimes affectionate way of addressing someone.

messages.en: It's getting late. Don't do any more work tonight. Take good care of yourself, okay?
Hehe, you even used 'dirimu'. Sounds like a love letter. Okay, I'm closing my laptop now.
It's because I miss you. Get some sleep. We'll chat again tomorrow.

senses.en_definition: Himself, herself, or itself; referring back to a person or animal mentioned in context.
The person themselves; emphasizing their identity, inner self, or personal circumstances.

messages.en: Faris lives on his own now, right? I'm worried he's not eating at regular times.
I just saw him yesterday. He knows how to look after himself now. He even cooks for himself. Don't worry so much.

senses.en_definition: There; at a place away from the speaker. Standard spelling: di sana.

messages.en: I'm at the entrance next to the pharmacy. Where are you?
Wait there for now. I'm almost there.
Okay, I'll wait right here. Message me when you get here, okay?
